entries.title: I Chronicles 20:1
segments: ¶And it came to pass at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go forth, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and laid waste the land of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David abode at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:2
segments: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was [set] upon David's head: and he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:3
segments: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with the saw, and with harrows of iron, and with saws. And so David did to all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:4
segments: ¶And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbechai the Hushathite smote Sippai, one of the children of Rapha; and they were subdued.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:5
segments: And there was again a battle with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair smote Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite; now the shaft of his spear was like a weaver's beam.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:6
segments: And there was again a battle, at Gath; and there was a man [there] of great stature, whose fingers [and toes] were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born to Rapha.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:7
segments: And he defied Israel; but Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother smote him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 20:8
segments: These were born to Rapha in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
